WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.length IS NOT NULL THEN f.length END) AS avg_length,
    AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS per_day_rate
  FROM film f
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
mean_per_day_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_stats
),
high_ratings AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_rate, m.overall_mean
  FROM rating_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN mean_per_day_rate m
  WHERE rs.per_day_rate > m.overall_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_length) AS average_length,
  AVG(per_day_rate) AS average_per_day_rate,
  AVG(per_day_rate - overall_mean) AS average_excess
FROM high_ratings
